Dropshipping Is 99% a Scam Built on False Get-Rich-Quick Promises Dropshipping is constantly promoted as an easy way to make money online. Start a store. Find a product. Run some ads. Make thousands while you sleep. The reality is very different. Most people selling the dropshipping dream make it sound far easier and more profitable than it actually is. They show revenue screenshots without showing ad spend, product costs, refunds, failed products and all the money lost testing along the way. Can dropshipping work? Yes. But the idea that almost anyone can start a store today and quickly become rich is where the scam comes in. Before buying another dropshipping course or believing another success story, understand the numbers behind the business. #Dropshipping #Ecommerce #OnlineBusiness #DigitalMarketing #Entrepreneurship
